/.title: IntentFlow — Engineer the search. Own the answer.
/.description: IntentFlow focuses on brand presence across Google, Bing, and AI answer engines.

hero.text: A Search Dominance Company
Engineer the search. Own the answer.

Buyers no longer search in one place. They discover, evaluate, and decide across Google, Bing, and AI answer engines. IntentFlow focuses on the moments when a search begins and when an AI-generated answer is formed.
Book a Discovery Call
Get a free AI visibility assessment

sections.heading: Search behavior no longer follows one path.

blocks.text: Buyers move between traditional search, recommendation platforms, and AI answer engines while they research a category and compare providers. IntentFlow treats those surfaces as parts of one search journey.
The autocomplete moment
IntentFlow OSA focuses on how a brand appears while a search query is still being formed in Google and Bing.
The AI answer moment
IntentFlow Authority focuses on how a brand is represented and cited when buyers use AI answer engines to research a category.

sections.heading: Three search disciplines. One coordinated strategy.

blocks.text: Search Engine Optimization
SEO addresses the pages and owned properties that appear in traditional search results.
Answer Engine Optimization
AEO addresses the structured answers, snippets, and response surfaces buyers can read without following a conventional result.
Generative Engine Optimization
GEO addresses how content and entities are represented in AI-generated answers and their cited sources.

sections.heading: Built around the buyer's search journey.

blocks.text: IntentFlow OSA, Authority, and Intelligent Traffic are presented as related services for autocomplete, AI-answer visibility, and coordinated search strategy.
Explore IntentFlow OSA
Explore IntentFlow Authority
What is IntentFlow OSA?
OSA is the IntentFlow service focused on brand visibility during the autocomplete stage of a Google or Bing search.
What is IntentFlow Authority?
Authority is the IntentFlow service focused on how a brand appears in AI-generated answers and citations.
What is Intelligent Traffic?
Intelligent Traffic brings those search surfaces into one coordinated strategy.

blocks.text: A buyer often begins with an unbranded category, service, or location query. IntentFlow OSA is designed around that early search-formation moment.

sections.heading: From a category query to an owned result.

blocks.text: Discover
Identify relevant ways buyers describe a need before they have chosen a provider.
Position
Develop a search strategy around the autocomplete suggestions associated with those needs.
Connect
Use the branded search journey to lead buyers toward the company's owned website and profiles.
OSA is presented for businesses whose customers actively search by service, category, specialty, or location. The industry pages show illustrative keyword patterns for those contexts.
View industry examples
Autocomplete diagrams on this website are conceptual examples. They do not represent live placements, customer accounts, campaign totals, or guaranteed outcomes.
Does OSA replace SEO?
No. OSA focuses on the formation of a search query, while SEO focuses on the owned pages and properties that appear in traditional results.
Are the keyword examples campaign data?
No. They are labeled examples showing how a category query, branded suggestion, and owned result relate to one another.
How are actual terms selected?
Actual planning should begin with the business category, service area, and available search-demand evidence.

/authority.title: IntentFlow Authority — AI Visibility Platform
/authority.description: IntentFlow Authority focuses on brand visibility in AI-generated answers.

hero.text: IntentFlow Authority · AI Visibility Platform
Get found in AI search.
IntentFlow Authority focuses on how brands appear in AI-generated answers across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok, Copilot, and other answer engines.
Schedule a Strategy Call
Get a free AI visibility assessment

sections.heading: AI answers are a separate search surface.

blocks.text: Buyers increasingly use AI assistants to research categories, compare approaches, and identify providers. Authority is the IntentFlow service focused on that answer layer.
Find
Review how the brand currently appears across relevant AI answers.
Fix
Identify content, entity, and source gaps that affect that representation.
Deploy
Apply approved changes through the brand's owned publishing workflow.
Review
Recheck the relevant answer surfaces and document what changed.
The Authority service is informed by published Generative Engine Optimization research and by ongoing observation of answer-engine behavior.
Read the GEO research
Content clarity, sourcing, and answer readiness.
Entity consistency across owned and external sources.
Technical delivery and the pages available to answer engines.
How the brand appears in relevant AI-generated answers.
Is Authority the same as traditional SEO?
No. Traditional SEO focuses on ranked search results. Authority focuses on representation inside AI-generated answers and citations.
Does the site show live AI recommendations?
No. Product diagrams are labeled conceptual previews and do not represent a customer's live account or a guaranteed recommendation.
Where does the research come from?
The research section links directly to the published GEO paper rather than presenting uncited performance claims.

Privacy Policy
The Osinoff Group, LLC · Last updated June 11, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how The Osinoff Group, LLC ("Osinoff Group," "we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and protects information when you visit www.osinoffgrp.com (the "Site") or engage with our IntentFlow services. We've written it in plain language. If anything is unclear, email greg@osinoffgrp.com .
We do not sell your personal information. We collect only what we need to respond to you and operate the Site.

blocks.text: The Osinoff Group, LLC is a search intelligence company based in Delray Beach, Florida. IntentFlow, IntentFlow OSA, and IntentFlow Authority are products and services of The Osinoff Group, LLC. For any privacy question or request, contact us at greg@osinoffgrp.com or +1 646 279 7307.
Information you give us

When you book a discovery call, request an assessment, or contact us, you may provide your name, business name, email address, phone number, website URL, market or location, and details about your business and search activity. You provide this voluntarily.
Information collected automatically

Like most websites, our Site may automatically collect limited technical information through your browser and standard analytics — such as your IP address, device and browser type, pages viewed, referring source, and general (city- or region-level) location. This helps us understand how the Site is used and improve it.
We use a small number of cookies and similar technologies to make the Site function and to measure aggregate usage. These fall into two groups:
Essential — required for the Site to load and operate. These are always on.
Analytics — help us understand aggregate traffic and improve content. These do not identify you personally.
You can control or disable cookies in your browser settings; disabling some may affect how the Site works. Where required by law, we will request your consent before setting non-essential cookies.
To respond to your inquiry, schedule calls, and prepare any assessment you request
To provide, maintain, and improve our Site and services
To communicate with you about your inquiry and, where you have opted in, about relevant updates
To comply with legal obligations and protect our rights
If you opt in to marketing communications, you can withdraw consent at any time using the unsubscribe link in any email or by emailing us.

We share information only as needed to operate: with service providers who help us run the Site and our business (for example, scheduling, email, and analytics providers), bound by confidentiality obligations; when required by law; or in connection with a business transfer. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising.
We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described here or as required by law, then delete or anonymize it.

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or port your personal information, and to opt out of certain processing. Residents of California (under the CCPA/CPRA) and other U.S. states with comprehensive privacy laws have these rights. To exercise them, email greg@osinoffgrp.com . We will not discriminate against you for exercising any privacy right.
We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect information. No method of transmission or storage is perfectly secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
The Site may link to third-party sites and tools (such as our scheduling provider). Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies, not this one.
The Site is intended for businesses and is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date above reflects the most recent version. Material changes will be posted on this page.
